newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit ends rangebound in KL after dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit ends rangebound in KL after dull trading.

text.p: The ringgit was bound to a tight range for most of the day on lack of interest despite release of Malaysia's second quarter GDP data, dealers said.
They said the ringgit was thinly traded in the afternoon after some early offshore buying, which was matched by commercial demand for the dollar.
At 1000 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4985/95 per dollar against 2.4981/84 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Friday. Sing dollar was at 0.5630/33 per ringgit against 0.5631/36.
"The way things are, ringgit should be in a range in the next few days," said a foreign exchange dealer.
